after: I imagine hearing your voice from another room and realising that, for once, I do not have to reach for my phone.
text: And sometimes, when I imagine that home, it is not only the two of us in it. I have imagined our children too. You want only two; I want four, so there is still a little negotiating left in our happily ever after. But two names already belong to the future we talk about: Zidan for a boy, and Zayna for a girl. We chose them together. I imagine calling those names from another room and looking over at you, amazed that a life we once pictured through a screen could become so ordinary and so ours. We have not agreed on how many little voices there might be. I just love that we have already made room for them in our dreams.
